description: Painted scene on a overcast shore beside a beached Viking longship with a carved dragon prow. An older white-haired man in a black embroidered robe gestures at a young man in plain tunic who pours silver coins from a sack onto a hanging balance scale. The scale is held by a bearded man in a fur-trimmed cloak with a sword at his belt. Coin sacks and iron weights lie in the mud, and armed warriors with spears and round shields stand behind. No visible text or frame.
